The first release of **clkr**, a lightweight, good-looking auto clicker for Windows.

**Download `clkr.exe` below**, put it anywhere and run it: no installer, no runtime, about 4 MB.
Website: https://syfleshka.github.io/clkr/

### Highlights

- **Speed**: up to 1000 clicks per second or an exact interval down to 1 ms, drift-free timing, optional human-like jitter.
- **Action**: left, middle or right button, single or double click, or any key (with Ctrl / Shift / Alt) sent as a scan code; adjustable hold time.
- **Location**: at the cursor, a fixed point, a random spot inside an area, or a route of points with per-point button, click type and pause.
- **On-screen picker**: full-screen overlay with a pixel loupe and live coordinates, exact on multi-monitor and mixed-DPI setups.
- **Stop conditions**: after N clicks, N route cycles or a time limit, with live progress and a clicks-per-second graph.
- **Global hotkeys**: F6 to start/stop (toggle or hold-to-click), F7 to add the point under the cursor to the route; mouse side buttons work too.
- **Comfort**: profiles, compact always-on-top mode, dark and light themes, English and Russian interface.
- **Safety**: never clicks its own window, stops when you move the mouse away, optional start delay.

### Notes

- The exe is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on the first start: *More info → Run anyway*.
- Requires 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 with OpenGL 2.0.
- Settings live in `%APPDATA%\clkr\clkr.json`; put an empty `clkr.json` next to the exe for portable mode.
